positions.statement: On his campaign site, under reducing costs for working families, Smith says Clackamas needs to be more affordable.
positions.excerpt: Clackamas needs to be more affordable.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Smith says he would push for clearer public accounting of where county costs come from, including utility increases, contracts and capital projects.
positions.excerpt: I will push for clearer public accounting of where costs are coming from, including utility increases, service contracts, and capital projects.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, under ending unsheltered homelessness, Smith says unhoused neighbors must be moved off the streets and into recovery-oriented care.
positions.excerpt: We must move unhoused neighbors off our streets and into recovery-oriented care.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Smith says ending unsheltered homelessness requires shelter capacity, behavioral health services, addiction treatment and pathways back into stable housing.
positions.excerpt: Ending unsheltered homelessness requires more than one tool. It means shelter capacity, behavioral health services, addiction treatment, and clear pathways back into stable housing.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Smith says more treatment options and more shelter beds are needed for people experiencing severe addiction.
positions.excerpt: We need more treatment options and more shelter beds for people experiencing severe addiction

positions.statement: On his campaign site, in opposing large-scale data centers, Smith says residents should know who pays for them and how they affect local electricity costs and reliability.
positions.excerpt: Residents should know who pays for these and how they affect local electricity costs and reliability.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, in opposing large-scale data centers, Smith says the county's water should prioritize families, farms, rivers, fish and future generations.
positions.excerpt: Clackamas County's water should prioritize families, farms, rivers, fish, and future generations

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Smith says rural Clackamas has an opportunity to support small-scale food production through targeted tax incentives.
positions.excerpt: In rural parts of Clackamas County, there is an opportunity to support small scale food production through targeted tax incentives.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, in opposing large-scale data centers, Smith says data centers consume vast amounts of electricity, requiring new substations and infrastructure.
positions.excerpt: Data centers consume vast amounts of electricity, requiring new substations and infrastructure.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Smith says Clackamas County should be clear that local agencies do not take part in federal immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant.
positions.excerpt: I believe Clackamas County should be clear that local agencies do not participate in federal immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, under keeping the community safe, Smith says the county will stand up for its neighbors while the federal government is targeting immigrants.
positions.excerpt: While the federal government is targeting immigrants, we will stand up for our neighbors

positions.statement: On his campaign site, under keeping the community safe, Smith says he will ensure families have access to the support they need.
positions.excerpt: ensure families have access to the support they need

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Smith says local government should work openly and responsibly for the people it serves.
positions.excerpt: the local government should work openly and responsibly for the people it serves.
